svg.text: PUPPET table: what to measure for the corner marker clip
Grey values = the Unity model (escritorio2_0.fbx at its scene scale). Measure the real table and write yours next to each letter.

g.text: clip reaches ~60 mm along each edge
anything under the top near the corner?
(legs, frame rails, hinges, casters: distance from both edges; model leg ≈ 100 mm in)
edge profile: square / rounded / chamfer / edge band
marker: diameter and mount (M4 thread / stem / adhesive)

svg.text: The real lab table is a flip-top folding table with castors; its leg layout differs from this model.
